title: Signal Station
author: Luke Steuber
description:
I wanted a small way to ask questions with a little context. Up captures the readings I choose, Select asks a spoken question, and Down opens recent saved history. Capture and History do not require an answer provider. The phone keeps full records.

Requires the experimental Pebble Inspector Lab Android companion. Bring your own provider key for questions. Location, weather, nearby signals, sensors, and supported watch health readings are individually optional.

By Luke Steuber.
releaseNotes: Three direct home shortcuts: Up Capture, Select Ask, Down History. Capture saves readings without an answer provider. History reads recent phone records. New antenna icon and contextual scrolling.
dashboardState: Local 1.2.0 candidate; last verified dashboard release remains Draft 1.1.0
